A few days ago, I went to Is Noor Nursing Home in Jogeshwari to visit Dr. Shabana Qureshi, and I had a very bad experience with her. It was my wife’s first delivery, and she conceived after 4 years. The doctor said that since the pregnancy happened after so many years, the chances of a normal delivery are very low and that we should not expect a normal delivery again and again.
From the way she was talking, it was very clear that she was not interested in doing a normal delivery, because the due date was 17 November, and we visited her on 29 October. She said that she didn’t want to take any risk and that the baby’s weight had increased a lot — around 3.5 kg — and that she wanted to “finish the delivery quickly.” She told us to come on 5 November, even though at that time the baby’s actual weight was only 2.7 kg.
Such statements mentally disturb a patient. My wife was mentally stable, but after hearing this, she felt dizzy due to stress.
From the beginning, we were doing the full treatment in Mumbai with Dr. Nagis Pethani. We went to Dr. Shabana only because Jogeshwari was far for us. But hearing such things was very discouraging.
Alhamdulillah, my wife delivered normally in Mumbra at Medford Hospital under Dr. Nishat Afreen. When we visited her on 30 October, she said the baby’s weight was fine and there was nothing to worry about. And Alhamdulillah, the delivery was normal.
Please stay away from such doctors who only focus on pushing patients towards surgery (C-section). May Allah protect all of us from such doctors.
